- https://developer.apple.com/documentation/vision/vnhumanbodypose3dobservation

Every point of 9 pose-estimation keypoint schemes (BlazePose 33, ML Kit 33, COCO 17, Halpe26, COCO-WholeBody 133, OpenPose BODY_25, OpenPose COCO 18, Apple Vision 2D, Apple Vision 3D), read on 2026-10-17 from each model's own source: Python and C++ source files, configs and READMEs on raw.githubusercontent.com (branch and SHA-256 of the bytes recorded per row), Google's ML Kit reference, and the JSON Apple serves for its Vision documentation. Index and name are copied exactly as the source spells them; Apple's joint names have no numeric index and carry a null one. usedBy lists only models a fetched source ties to the scheme. One column is DERIVED: crosswalkKey, the name lowercased with every character outside a-z0-9 removed; sharedWith lists the other schemes with a point of the same key. Points are joined on that key and nothing else, so names that differ (MOUTH_LEFT and LEFT_MOUTH, RShoulder and right_shoulder) are not joined.

## Fields

| Field | Description | JSON types | Null in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scheme` | The scheme's slug on this site | string | 0 of 321 rows |
| `schemeName` | The scheme's name | string | 0 of 321 rows |
| `index` | The integer index the source assigns; null for Apple Vision's named joint constants | integer, null | 36 of 321 rows |
| `name` | The point's name exactly as the source spells it | string | 0 of 321 rows |
| `altNames` | Other spellings of the same index in the cross-checked sources, where they differ | null, string | 271 of 321 rows |
| `description` | The source's own description of the point, verbatim (ML Kit, Apple); null elsewhere | null, string | 252 of 321 rows |
| `group` | Apple's documentation topic group; null elsewhere | null, string | 285 of 321 rows |
| `crosswalkKey` | DERIVED: name lowercased, characters outside a-z0-9 removed | string | 0 of 321 rows |
| `sharedWith` | Other schemes with a point of the same crosswalkKey; null when none (unmapped) | null, string | 127 of 321 rows |
| `usedBy` | Models a fetched source ties to the scheme | string | 0 of 321 rows |
| `source` | The file or page the names and indices were copied from | string | 0 of 321 rows |
| `sourceBranch` | The GitHub branch read; null for documentation pages | null, string | 69 of 321 rows |
| `sourceSha256` | SHA-256 of the source bytes as served | string | 0 of 321 rows |
| `page` | This site's row for the point | string | 0 of 321 rows |

A null means the source does not state the value or it could not be verified. It never means zero, and it is never a guess. In the CSV a null is an empty unquoted field.

## Update cadence

- `src/data/poseKeypoints.ts` is generated by `scripts/fetch-pose-keypoints.mjs` from the sources above, last read 2026-10-17.
- No workflow runs that script: it is run by hand when the sources are re-read.
- The files are rebuilt by `npm run datasets` (scripts/build-datasets.mjs); a run with no source change writes byte-identical files. The edition stays 2026.1, and a new edition ships under a new file name rather than overwriting this one.
